problem:
$$
v=[\begin{aligned}a \\ b \\ c\end{aligned}],\,A=[\begin{aligned}10 & -7 & -3 \\ 8 & -5 & -3 \\ 10 & -8 & -2\end{aligned}]
$$

The vector $v$ and the matrix $A$ are given above. 
If $v$ is an eigenvector of $A$ that corresponds to the eigenvalue $\lambda =2,$ then what is the value of $\frac{a}{b}?$
